name: report_progress
description: Set or update the step plan and the current step. Call once at the start with the full plan, then each time a step finishes. Updates the ticket's progress bar (step x of n).

steps.description: Full ordered plan. Omit to keep the existing plan.

step.description: 0-based index of the step now active.

reason.description: Required when the plan changes after work has started.
